description: Land Acquisition -  Bemmulla, Kadaoluwawa, Heendeniya, Dadagamuwa, Pattigoda and Paramulla, Attanagalla D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a detailed order from the Minister of Lands directing the taking of possession of specific land parcels, followed by an extensive schedule listing numerous land lots with their descriptions, extents, and boundaries. The core subject matter is land and property-related, fitting the definition of a Land Gazette (Type 4). While a government minister is named, the notice is not about his appointment or portfolio responsibilities, but rather about his exercise of statutory powers related to land matters.
